sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If
you invest in our Class A Ordinary Shares, your interest will be diluted immediately to the extent of the difference between the public
offering price per share and the adjusted net tangible book value per share of our Class A Ordinary Shares after this offering. Our
net tangible book value on December 31, 2025, was approximately $15.58 million, or $3.83 per Class A Ordinary Share.
Upon our issuance of 60,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares subsequent to December 31, 2025 and prior to the date hereof,
including the issuances in the July 2026 Private Placement and the August 2026 Private Placement, for approximately $11.72 million, our
adjusted net tangible book value on December 31, 2025 would have been approximately $27.30 million, or $0.43 per Class
A Ordinary Share. “Net tangible book value” is total assets minus the sum of liabilities and intangible assets.
